avoid.product_type: Apple-branded hero products (AirPods, iPad, AirTag devices directly)
avoid.reason: Apple products are locked to authorized retailers, MAP pricing enforced, and margins razor-thin to negative for unauthorized resellers — dropshipping Apple hardware directly is legally and financially unfeasible.

avoid.product_type: Amazon-branded subscription services and devices (Blink Plus Plan, Fire TV Sticks as primary SKU)
avoid.reason: Amazon-exclusive services and heavily Amazon-subsidized hardware cannot be dropshipped; Amazon controls pricing, fulfillment, and the customer relationship entirely — zero resell opportunity.

avoid.product_type: Ultra-budget wired headphones under $15 retail (Sony ZX110 tier)
avoid.reason: Sub-$15 retail price leaves insufficient margin after platform fees, payment processing, and shipping — any return or customer service issue immediately eliminates profitability on these commodity items.

avoid.product_type: Amazon Basics branded commodity products (sheet sets, hangers, microfiber items under Amazon label)
avoid.reason: Amazon Basics competes at cost and occupies top-of-search placement with Prime badge — attempting to dropship against Amazon's own label in price-sensitive commodity categories results in margin destruction and poor conversion.

avoid.product_type: Full-size heavy appliances or oversized smart home devices
avoid.reason: Oversized or heavy items incur dimensional weight shipping surcharges that collapse dropship margins, and customer return logistics on large items are prohibitively expensive for margin preservation.

analysis.market_insights:
September 2026 is presenting dropshippers with a narrow but highly profitable pre-Q4 window. The Amazon data reveals three dominant macro trends converging simultaneously: the home office power accessory boom (multiple surge protector and charger SKUs dominating Electronics top 20), the insulated drinkware accessory ecosystem maturing around Owala and Stanley, and a pest control seasonal peak that will close within 3–4 weeks. Dropshippers who move immediately on flat-plug power strips, multi-port wall chargers, and drinkware accessories can capture September demand while positioning inventory sourcing pipelines for the October–December gifting surge. The competitive window is tightest on power accessories — act within one week.

The absence of TikTok-specific trend data in today's scrape is a meaningful gap: historically, September sees TikTok 'fall setup' and 'dorm transformation' content waves that drive 3–5x organic traffic spikes for LED lighting, desk organization, and cozy home products. Dropshippers should independently verify TikTok momentum for heated blankets, electric spin scrubbers, and fidget toy bundles using TikTok Creative Center and Kalodata before allocating budget. Apple ecosystem accessories (AirTag holders, AirPods Pro cases) represent the single best risk-adjusted opportunity heading into Q4 — high perceived value, lightweight, and benefiting from new hardware launch install base growth without the legal risk of reselling Apple hardware directly.
analysis.data_quality_note: Today's dataset contained strong Amazon bestseller data across Electronics and Home & Kitchen but lacked TikTok trending data and Google Trends/Shopping query data entirely, requiring all TikTok and Google signals to be inferred from historical seasonal patterns and platform knowledge rather than live scrape data — treat TikTok-attributed signals as directional estimates requiring independent verification.
